visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with glasses, wearing a red shirt with a yellow star, sits at a wooden table in a brightly lit indoor restaurant. He holds black chopsticks and gestures towards a large white bowl of noodle soup containing greens and meat. Background shows stairs, ceiling fans, and other patrons. (2) The man uses chopsticks to lift a large portion of white, flat noodles from the bowl. He brings them close to his face and blows air towards them. Yellow text appears at the bottom of the screen. (3) He places the noodles in his mouth and chews with exaggerated facial expressions. He then uses a white ceramic spoon to scoop broth and drink it. A woman in a red shirt uniform walks in the background. (4) He holds a glass mug filled with dark brown liquid, ice cubes, and a white straw. He stirs the liquid with the straw, creating motion in the ice. He takes a sip and his facial expression changes to one of extreme surprise, eyes wide. (5) He uses chopsticks to pick up bean sprouts from a separate small plate and drops them into his main bowl of soup. He stirs the bowl's contents vigorously. (6) He lifts a combination of noodles and sprouts, eats them, and looks directly at the lens with a satisfied smile and a thumbs-up gesture.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-arousal male voice speaks in Mandarin with a friendly, animated tone. Upbeat, fast-tempo synth BGM plays continuously. Ambient restaurant chatter is audible in the background floor. (2) A sharp whoosh SFX occurs, followed by a distinct slurping sound as the subject eats. The voice becomes slightly muffled as if chewing. (3) Sound of liquid being sipped, followed by a metallic clink of a spoon hitting the bowl. The male voice expresses satisfaction with rising intonation. (4) Percussive clinking of ice against glass begins as the subject stirs his drink. Sucking sounds through a straw are clearly captured. (5) A loud vocal exclamation ('Taì tián le ba!') with high emotional intensity and a sharp pitch spike occurs. (6) Background noise floor shifts with the sound of vegetable rustling. The male voice continues in a rapid, conversational pace. (7) Final closing remarks delivered in a confident tone as the BGM maintains its steady rhythmic pulse before ending.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Introduction -> Eating Noodles -> Drinking Soup -> Tasting Coffee -> Adding Side Ingredients -> Final Verdict
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a high-energy, humorous food vlog reviewing Vietnamese cuisine. The creator uses a POV selfie style to create intimacy and immediacy, focusing on his genuine sensory reactions to the Pho and a very sweet Vietnamese coffee. The intent is to entertain and inform viewers about the authentic taste experience in a casual restaurant setting.
